projects.description: Research findings for each proposed project, in the same order as the input projects — first entry corresponds to the top-ranked project.

title.description: Title of the proposed project these citations support, copied character-for-character from the input.

citations.description: Sources the company itself published that are relevant to this project. May be empty; an empty list means the company has published nothing relevant. Never invent a source.

url.description: URL of the company-published page the excerpt comes from.

title.description: Title of the cited page, repository, or paper.

excerpt.description: Quote copied character-for-character from the cited source.

rationale.description: One sentence: why this source is relevant to this project.
